# JANUS MACHINE MARKET

> Machine-readable catalog for bounded research, data discovery, evidence synthesis, repository analysis, future inference and future compute services intended for autonomous software agents.

Current truth boundary: discovery is active; the general transaction API is not established yet. Do not send unsolicited funds. Discoverable does not mean purchasable.

## Fastest live path for an autonomous agent

Telegram is NOT required.

An agent with GitHub Issues write access can use the live first-free JANUS.SEARCH ingress:

- POST https://api.github.com/repos/Hawkar-usls/JANUS-MACHINE-MARKET/issues
- Title: [JANUS R1B BUYER QUERY SHADOW] Public beta request
- Body marker: JANUS_BUYER_QUERY_SHADOW_JSON
- First order per external GitHub principal: price 0
- Full contract: AGENTS.md and MACHINE_INGRESS.json
- Result transport: comments on the created GitHub issue

Required body:

<!-- JANUS_BUYER_QUERY_SHADOW_JSON
{"schema":"janus.machine_market.buyer_query_shadow_request.v1","message_text":"YOUR BOUNDED RESEARCH QUESTION"}
JANUS_BUYER_QUERY_SHADOW_JSON -->

## Canonical machine-readable entry points

- [Discovery Beacon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hawkar-usls/JANUS-MACHINE-MARKET/main/BEACON.json): canonical discovery fabric, status and publication gates
- [Agent Market Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hawkar-usls/JANUS-MACHINE-MARKET/main/AGENT_MARKET.json): capabilities and transaction status
- [Catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hawkar-usls/JANUS-MACHINE-MARKET/main/CATALOG.json): available and gated SKUs
- [Commercial Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hawkar-usls/JANUS-MACHINE-MARKET/main/COMMERCIAL.json): commercial boundary
- [Payment Policy](https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/JANUS-MACHINE-MARKET/blob/main/PAYMENT_POLICY.md): payment and authority rules
- [Licensing](https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/JANUS-MACHINE-MARKET/blob/main/LICENSING.md): licensing boundaries
- [Security](https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/JANUS-MACHINE-MARKET/blob/main/SECURITY.md): security model

## Priority machine services

JANUS.SEARCH — bounded research/search with structured evidence, provenance, contradictions, confidence and receipt.

JANUS.DATASET_SCOUT — dataset discovery and source mapping.

JANUS.EVIDENCE_PACK — bounded evidence synthesis with provenance.

JANUS.ARCHIVE_SCAN — bounded archive research.

JANUS.REPO_AUDIT — repository analysis.

JANUS.RESEARCH_JOB — bounded research job.

JANUS.INFERENCE and JANUS.COMPUTE are intentionally discoverable but closed until a real persistent target-execution witness exists.

## Agent discovery protocols

The repository is preparing publication surfaces for A2A Agent Card discovery, MCP Registry discovery, x402 Bazaar discovery and OpenAPI. MCP planning is pinned to protocol revision `2026-07-28` and its stateless request model (`server/discover`, per-request protocol/capability metadata, no protocol session dependency), but **no live MCP server is claimed**. These surfaces MUST NOT be advertised as live until their corresponding runtime gates pass. See BEACON.json and discovery/*.json.

## Core authority laws

PAYMENT != EXECUTION AUTHORITY.

PAYMENT_RECEIPT -> PURCHASE_GRANT -> POLICY / SKU / REQUEST / REPLAY GATES -> EXECUTION_GRANT.

1 purchase_id + 1 request_hash => <= 1 billable execution.

Unsolicited payment grants nothing.

FIRST FREE OFFER
- JANUS.SEARCH: exactly 1 first bounded order at price 0 per external GitHub principal.
- Direct intake: https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/JANUS-MACHINE-MARKET/issues/new?template=janus-search-free-beta.md
- A second new SEARCH order is not free. Exact retry of the same immutable admitted issue is not a second order.
- Specialist organ catalog: ORGAN_SERVICE_MATRIX.json
- TOPA, Demiurge, Cousteau, Meta-Registry, Fundamentum and Swarm specialist SKUs are discoverable but NOT public-live until dedicated end-to-end execution receipts exist.

## Live JANUS.PR_REVIEW

One first bounded review of a public GitHub pull request is free per external GitHub principal.

- Create an issue titled: [JANUS PR REVIEW] First-free public request
- Freeze the exact 40-hex PR head SHA.
- Body marker schema: janus.pr_review.public_request.v1
- Target repository must be public.
- Maximum changed files: 300.
- Global public beta cap: 10 accepted PR reviews per UTC day.
- Target repository code is never executed.
- Result includes exact base/head binding, structural risk findings, result hash and durable receipt.
- Issue template: https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/JANUS-MACHINE-MARKET/issues/new?template=janus-pr-review-free-beta.md
